notes.title: Fixed achievements!
notes.content:
Problems were found in the game after the last update with the flashlight. Two achievements didn't work in the game:
1. Start the game;
2. Kill the boss.
Now they are working properly.

notes.title: Fixed an annoying moment
notes.content:
The game has a major update. The game has fixed a nuance with the installation of dynamite in the burrows of insects. Now this process has been simplified!
Also, 1 very easy achievement was added to the game - a first aid kit. To get it, just use the first-aid kit once.

notes.title: Fixed bug on 4th location
notes.content:
A bug has been fixed on the fourth level of the game! The error was in the display, at the start of the level, the graphical interface, which should be shown to the player at the death of the main character.
Good luck! :lunar2019coolpig:

notes.title: DLC
notes.content: Now DLC is loaded into the folder with the game without problems.
